name: St. Galler Kantonalbank AG
summary: St. Galler Kantonalbank AG, a cantonal bank, provides banking products and services to the local population, and small and middle-sized companies in Switzerland. It offers asset management products, including investment packages and structured products; equities, derivatives, bonds, in-house and third-party funds, and customized structured products; services, such as mortgages, Lombard loans, sureties, guarantees, etc.; and financial planning services comprising succession planning, inheritance advice, retirement planning, and wealth tax advisory services, as well as inheritance advice, payment transaction, and e-banking services.
